y-m-48-04.title: Edza tsumo inoti 'kana square yakakura, yakakura'
y-m-48-04.topic: Mienzaniso inopikisa nemamiriro ekuwedzera anoita kuti chirevo chishande
y-m-48-04.goal: Gadzira iwe pachako muenzaniso unopikisa kuchirevo chenhema, tsvaga mamiriro ekuwedzera akawanda anoita kuti chirevo chishande, uye utsanangure nei uchishandisa zviratidzo nema squares.
y-m-48-04.material: Kune real numbers a ne b, Hyunwoo akati, "'Kana a²>b², saka a>b' ndeye chokwadi. Inoshanda kana a=3, b=2 uye yakashandawo kana a=5, b=1." (a² inoverengwa 'a squared'.)
y-m-48-04.prereq.1: Zvimiro zve inequalities nezvinoreva absolute value
y-m-48-04.prereq.2: Muenzaniso unopikisa wechirevo (muenzaniso apo hypothesis inoshanda uye mhedziso isingashande)
y-m-48-04.s.s1.prompt: Isa mapeya akarongwa matatu akasiyana (a, b) anoratidza kuti chirevo chaHyunwoo 'Kana a²>b², saka a>b' ndeye nhema. (a ne b ndema real numbers.)
y-m-48-04.s.s1.hint.0: Unoda peya apo hypothesis inoshanda uye mhedziso isingashande. Sarudza a ne b dzakati uye tanga wayenzanisa a² ne b².
y-m-48-04.s.s1.hint.1: Edza kana muenzaniso unopikisa unoonekwa kana a ne b zvose zviri positive, wozoedzawo nyaya apo zviratidzo zvakasiyana nenyaya apo zvose zviri negative.

y-m-48-04.s.s1.fail.c2: a>b inoshanda. Mhedziso yakarurama, saka uyu hausi muenzaniso unopikisa.
y-m-48-04.s.s1.explain: Hypothesis a²>b² zvinoreva zvakafanana ne |a|>|b|. Kana a iri negative ine absolute value hombe, senge (−3, 1), saka a²>b² asi a<b, saka ndiwo muenzaniso unopikisa. Kushandisa nhamba positive chete hakupi muenzaniso unopikisa.
y-m-48-04.s.s2.prompt: Tinoda kuwedzera mamiriro mumwe kuti chirevo chaHyunwoo chive chechokwadi. Sarudza mamiriro ose anoita kuti chirevo chigare chiri chechokwadi kana awedzerwa. (a ne b ndema real numbers.)
y-m-48-04.s.s2.hint.0: Shandisa mamiriro ega ega kumapeya emienzaniso inopikisa yawakagadzira mudanho rekutanga uye utarise kana muenzaniso unopikisa unoramba uripo pasi pemamiriro iwayo.
y-m-48-04.s.s2.hint.1: Edza kugadzira iwe pachako mapeya apo a iri 0 kana kupfuura, a²>b², uye a≤b, uye utarise kana izvozvo zvichigoneka.
y-m-48-04.s.s2.o.a: b iri 0 kana kupfuura uye a ndi real number chero ipi
y-m-48-04.s.s2.r.a: (−3, 1) inorambairi muenzaniso unopikisa pasi pemamiriro aya. Kunyangwe b iri 0 kana kupfuura, a inogona kuva negative.
y-m-48-04.s.s2.o.c: a ne b ndema real numbers akasiyana
y-m-48-04.s.s2.r.c: (−3, 1) muenzaniso unopikisa kunyangwe ari ma real numbers akasiyana.
y-m-48-04.s.s2.r.e: (−3, 1) peya yema integers. Mamiriro ekuva ma integers haagadziriri dambudziko rezviratidzo.
y-m-48-04.s.s2.explain: Kana a≥0, saka kubva ku a²>b² tinowana a=|a|>|b|≥b, saka ndeye chokwadi. Mamiriro ekuti a ne b zvose zviri positive anopfuura iri, saka ndeye chokwadi zvakare. Kune zvimwe zvose, (−3, 1) inoramba iri muenzaniso unopikisa.
y-m-48-04.s.s2.acc.0: Mamiriro ekuti a iri 0 kana kupfuura anokwana oga kuita kuti chirevo chive chechokwadi. Asi wakasiya kuti mamiriro 'a ne b zvose zviri positive' anokwanawo.

y-m-48-02.title: 'x=2' mamiriro erudzi rupi ku 'x²=4'?
y-m-48-02.topic: Necessary ne sufficient conditions, nechiitiko che universal set
y-m-48-02.goal: Tsanangura nemienzaniso inopikisa ne truth sets kuti kutonga necessary kana sufficient condition kunogona kuchinja ne universal set, uye ugadzire imwe condition ine zvinoreva zvakafanana.
y-m-48-02.material: Condition p: x²=4, condition q: x=2. Hukama pakati pemamiriro maviri hunogona kuchinja ne universal set (renji renhamba dzingava x), saka tarisa universal set nguva dzose. (x²=4 inoverengwa 'x squared equals 4', uye |x|=2 inoverengwa 'the absolute value of x is 2'.)
y-m-48-02.thinking.0: Tonga hukama hwemamiriro ne truth sets
y-m-48-02.thinking.1: Chinja kutonga zvichienderana neruzivo rutsva (shanduko ye universal set)
y-m-48-02.thinking.2: Tsanangura nemuenzaniso unopikisa kuti nei chimwe chinhu chisiri necessary condition
y-m-48-02.prereq.1: Zvinoreva truth set ne subset relation
y-m-48-02.prereq.2: Chokwadi kana nhema yechirevo 'kana ..., saka ...' nemienzaniso inopikisa
y-m-48-02.s.s1.prompt: Tevera kuti kutonga kunochinja sei nguva imwe neimwe universal set nemamiriro zvichichinja.
y-m-48-02.s.s1.hint.0: Padanho rimwe nerimwe, nyora x dzose dzinogutsa p uye x dzose dzinogutsa q mukati me universal set.
y-m-48-02.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa mapoka maviri: rimwe rinokwana rose mukati merimwe here, kana akaenzana?
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.0.info: Universal set ndi real numbers dzose. Condition p: x²=4, condition q: x=2.
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.0.ask: q ndiyo condition yerudzi rupi ye p? (Tarisa zvakaparadzana kana 'kana q saka p' uye kana 'kana p saka q'.)
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.0.after: Kana x=2, saka x²=4, saka 'kana q saka p' ndeye chokwadi. Asi x=−2 inogutsa p uye haigutsi q, saka 'kana p saka q' ndeye nhema. Saka q ndiyo sufficient condition ye p, asi haisi necessary condition.
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Necessary condition asi haisi sufficient condition chaiyo
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Tanga watarisa kana 'kana q saka p' inoshanda. Chii chinoitika kana waisa x=2 mu p?
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Uku kutonga kwakaitwa nekucherechedza kuti 'kana q saka p' ndeye chokwadi uye 'kana p saka q' ndeye nhema.
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Tarisa kana 2 iri x yega inogutsa p.
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Wakatarisa here kana 'kana q saka p' inoshanda? Isa x=2 mu p.
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.1.info: Zvino dzikisa universal set kuva 'real numbers dzose dzine positive'. p: x²=4 ne q: x=2 zvinoramba zvakadaro.
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.1.ask: Mu universal set iyi, q ndiyo condition yerudzi rupi ye p?
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.1.after: Pakati pe positive real numbers, 2 ndiyo x yega ine x²=4, saka truth set ye p ne truth set ye q dzakaenzana. Saka mu universal set iyi ndiyo necessary ne sufficient condition. Kunyangwe nemamiriro akafanana, kutonga kunogona kuchinja kana universal set ichichinja.
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wakachengeta kutonga kwako kwekutanga sezvakaita. Nyora kuti boka re x dzinogutsa p rinochinja sei kana universal set ichidzikira.
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Tanga nekutarisa kana 'kana q saka p' inoshanda. Mu universal set iyi zvakare, x=2 inogutsa p.
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wakatonga izvi nekuona kuti boka re x dzinogutsa p neboka re x dzinogutsa q zvakafanana.
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Universal set yakachinja, saka hazvigoni kutongwa
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Kana universal set yagadziriswa, unogona kutonga. Nyora x dzose dzinogutsa p ne q mukati mayo.
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.2.info: Dzorera universal set kuma real numbers dzose. Panguva ino, chengeta p sezvakaita uye uchinje q kuita imwe condition kuti ive necessary ne sufficient condition ye p.
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.2.ask: Sarudza condition inogona kutsiva q. (Inopfuura imwe ingava yakarurama.)
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.2.after: Truth set ye p ndi {−2, 2}. Vose |x|=2 ne 'x=2 kana x=−2' ndizvo chaizvo seti iyi, saka ndidzo necessary ne sufficient conditions uye ndedzimwe nzira dzekutaura dzine zvinoreva zvakafanana. x>0 inosiya −2, uye x²≥4 inobvumira makosha akawanda akadai se3.
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Inosanganisira x=2 chete uye inosiya x=−2. Iienzanise ne truth set {−2, 2} ye p.
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Inosanganisira x=2 ne x=−2 zvose, saka inova yakaenzana ne truth set ye p.
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Inosanganisira x dzose dzinogutsa p, asi inobatawo makosha akadai se x=3 asingagutsi p.
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Uku kutonga kunotora truth set {−2, 2} ye p sezvainei.
y-m-48-02.s.s1.reflect: Chikonzero chekuchinja kutonga mudanho 2 hachisi chekuti mamiriro akachinja asi chekuti universal set yakachinja. Nemashoko ako pachako, pfupisa kuti condition imwe chete inogona kuva ne truth set yakasiyana zvichienderana ne universal set. Nzira yakachinjwa nayo q mudanho 3 inogona kutsanangurwa sei ne truth sets?
y-m-48-02.s.s2.prompt: Tsanangura, uchishandisa kukosha kumwe chaiko kwe x, kuti nei unogona kutaura kuti 'x=2 haisi necessary condition ye x²=4' kana universal set iri real numbers dzose.

y-m-48-02.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora x dzose dzinogutsa p, uye utsvage dzimwe dzacho dzisingagutsi q.
y-m-48-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Zvakajeka here kuti p yechokwadi uye q yenhema kukosha kwawakasarudza?
y-m-48-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora here chinongedzo chekuti sezvo 'kana p saka q' iri yenhema, q haisi necessary condition?
y-m-48-02.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakadzivisa here kusanganisa nzira dzenecessary ne sufficient?
y-m-48-02.s.s2.model.0: Kana x=−2, saka x²=4, saka p inoshanda, asi x haisi 2, saka q haishande. Saka 'kana p saka q' ndeye nhema, uye q haisi necessary condition ye p.

'Kana x≤2, saka x²≤4' ndicho chirevo (inverse) chakagadzirwa nokupikisa hypothesis nemhedziso rimwe nerimwe chete, apo contrapositive inoita kuti kupikisa kwemhedziso kuve hypothesis nokupikisa kwehypothesis kuve mhedziso: 'Kana x²≤4, saka x≤2'. Ndicho chikonzero mhedziso pamutsetse 5 yakanganisawo. Mutsetse 1 watoratidza kuti p ichokwadi, uye contrapositive chaiyo 'Kana x²≤4, saka x≤2' ichokwadi. Kuverenga pamutsetse 4 (x=−3) kwakarurama kuchirevo chakavakwa zvisizvo.
y-m-48-01.s.s2.prompt: Kunyange p ichokwadi, converse ya p inogona kusava yechokwadi. Isa nhamba chaiyo x 2 dzakasiyana dzinoratidza kuti converse 'Kana x²>4, saka x>2' haisi yechokwadi.
y-m-48-01.s.s2.hint.0: Paradzanisa x dzinosangana nehypothesis x²>4 yeconverse kuva dziri pamusoro nenegative, uye unyore mashoma ega ega.
y-m-48-01.s.s2.hint.1: Pakukosha kwega kwega kwawakanyora, tarisa kana mhedziso x>2 ichishanda, uye usarudze kukosha apo isingashande.
y-m-48-01.s.s2.ok.c1: x² yakakura kupfuura 4, saka hypothesis yeconverse inoshanda.
y-m-48-01.s.s2.fail.c1: x² haina kukura kupfuura 4. Hypothesis yeconverse haishande, saka kukosha uku hakugoni kuva muenzaniso unopikisa.
y-m-48-01.s.s2.ok.c2: x ndi 2 kana shoma, saka mhedziso yeconverse 'x>2' haishande.
y-m-48-01.s.s2.fail.c2: x yakakura kupfuura 2. Mhedziso 'x>2' inoshanda, saka uyu hausi muenzaniso unopikisa.
y-m-48-01.s.s2.explain: x²>4 inoshanda kana x>2 kana x<−2. Kukosha kune x<−2 (semuenzaniso −3, −2.5, −5) kunosangana nehypothesis uye kunoputsa mhedziso, saka converse haisi yechokwadi.
y-m-48-01.s.s3.prompt: Chirevo chitsva q: "Kana x iri kuwanda kwe 6, saka x kuwanda kwe 3" (x inhamba yakazara) chichokwadi. Pakati peconverse, inverse, necontrapositive ya q, ndeipi inogona kutaurwa pakarepo kuti ichokwadi kubva pachokwadi cha q oga?
y-m-48-01.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora q, converse, inverse, necontrapositive mumabhokisi e "hypothesis → mhedziso," uye uratidze kuti ndeipi yazvo inochinja mabhokisi a q uye sei.
y-m-48-01.s.s3.hint.1: Kune dzaunofungira kuti dzichokwadi, isa kukosha se 3, 6, 9 uye uyedze kuti hapana muenzaniso unopikisa unobuda.
y-m-48-01.s.s3.o.a: Inverse ye q: Kana x isiri multiple ye6, saka x haisi multiple ye3
y-m-48-01.s.s3.r.a: x=3 muenzaniso unopikisa. 3 haisi multiple ye6, asi ndi multiple ye3. Izvi hazvienderani nechokwadi chechirevo chekutanga.
y-m-48-01.s.s3.o.b: Contrapositive ye q: Kana x isiri multiple ye3, saka x haisi multiple ye6
y-m-48-01.s.s3.o.c: Converse ye q: Kana x iri multiple ye3, saka x ndi multiple ye6
y-m-48-01.s.s3.r.c: x=3 muenzaniso unopikisa. 3 ndi multiple ye3 asi haisi multiple ye6. Kunyangwe chirevo chekutanga chiri chechokwadi, chokwadi che converse chinofanira kuongororwa zvakaparadzana.
y-m-48-01.s.s3.o.d: Kune converse, inverse, ne contrapositive, hapana inogona kutaurwa kuti ndeye chokwadi kubva pa q oga
y-m-48-01.s.s3.r.d: Contrapositive inogara iine chokwadi chakafanana nechirevo chekutanga. Tanga warongedza kuti ndeipi iri contrapositive.
y-m-48-01.s.s3.explain: Contrapositive inogara iine chokwadi chakafanana nechirevo chekutanga, saka kana q iri yechokwadi, contrapositive "Kana x isiri multiple ye3, saka x haisi multiple ye6" inewo chokwadi. Converse ne inverse zvinofanira kutariswa zvakaparadzana kubva pa q, uye munyaya ino x=3 muenzaniso unopikisa, saka zvose zviri zvenhema.

y-m-48-03.title: Tsvaga kukosha kwe a kunoita sufficient condition
y-m-48-03.topic: Inclusion ye truth sets nerenji reletter a
y-m-48-03.goal: Shandura sufficient condition kuita inclusion ye truth sets, gadzira makosha akawanda anogoneka eletter a, uye utsanangure kuti kusanganisira kana kusasanganisira magumo kunokanganisa sei renji.
y-m-48-03.material: Pane mamiriro maviri nezve real number x. p: −1≤x≤2, q: |x−a|≤3 (a ndi real number). Tinoda kusarudza a kuti 'kana p saka q' ive yechokwadi. (|x−a| inoverengwa 'the absolute value of x minus a'. |x−a|≤3 zvinoreva kuti x iri 3 kana pasi kubva ku a.)

y-m-48-03.s.s1.prompt: Kana 'kana p saka q' iri yechokwadi, izvi zvinoreva chii nezve P ne Q, mapoka e x (truth sets) anogutsa p ne q?
y-m-48-03.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora nemashoko kuti x ingada kuva yakadini kuti 'kana p saka q' ive yenhema.
y-m-48-03.s.s1.hint.1: Edza mutsara nemapoka madiki senge P={1, 2}, Q={1, 2, 3} kuti uone kana unokodzera.
y-m-48-03.s.s1.o.a: X dzose dziri mu Q dziri muPwo
y-m-48-03.s.s1.r.a: Nzira yakadzoserwa. 'Kana p saka q' zvinoreva kuti kana p ikagutswa, q inogutswawo.
y-m-48-03.s.s1.o.b: Pane x imwe chete kana kupfuura iri mu P ne Q zvose
y-m-48-03.s.s1.r.b: Kufukidzana panzvimbo imwe chete kwakasiyana ne x dzose dze P dziri mukati me Q. Kana pane x muPwo isiri mu Q, ndiyo muenzaniso unopikisa.
y-m-48-03.s.s1.o.c: X dzose dziri mu P dziri muQwo
y-m-48-03.s.s1.o.d: P ne Q dzine huwandu hwe x hwakafanana
y-m-48-03.s.s1.r.d: Kuva nehuwandu hwakafanana hakuiti kuti mapoka aenzane kana kuti rimwe rikwane mukati merimwe.
y-m-48-03.s.s1.explain: 'Kana p saka q' kuva yechokwadi zvinoreva kuti x dzose dzinogutsa p dzinogutsawo q, saka P⊂Q.
y-m-48-03.s.s2.prompt: Isa ma real numbers a 4 akasiyana anoita kuti p: −1≤x≤2 ive sufficient condition ye q: |x−a|≤3. Haafaniri kuva ma integers.
y-m-48-03.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora zvakare |x−a|≤3 serenji (interval) re x, uye uridhirowe pa number line pamwe chete ne P.
y-m-48-03.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza kukosha kwe a uye utarise kana magumo ose maviri −1 ne2 e P ari mukati merenji re q.
y-m-48-03.s.s2.ok.c1: Magumo ekuruboshwe a−3 ye q ndi −1 kana pasi, saka inosvika kumagumo ekuruboshwe e P.
y-m-48-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Magumo ekuruboshwe a−3 ye q akakura kupfuura −1, saka chikamu chedivi rekuruboshwe re P chiri kunze kwe q.
y-m-48-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Magumo ekurudyi a+3 ye q ndi2 kana kupfuura, saka inosvika kumagumo ekurudyi e P.
y-m-48-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Magumo ekurudyi a+3 ye q ari pasi pe2, saka chikamu chedivi rekurudyi re P chiri kunze kwe q.
y-m-48-03.s.s2.explain: q ndi a−3≤x≤a+3. Kuti P={x | −1≤x≤2} ikwane rose mukati me Q, tinoda a−3≤−1 ne2≤a+3, saka −1≤a≤2. Kukosha kwose murenji iri ndimhinduro dzakarurama.
y-m-48-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Kana a=3, saka p haisi sufficient condition ye q. Tsanangura nei nekupa kukosha kumwe chaiko kwe x mu P.
y-m-48-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Isa a=3 mu expression ye q uye unyore q seinterval ye x.
y-m-48-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Tsvaga uye unyore x imwe mu P isiri mu interval ye q.
y-m-48-03.s.s2.because.placeholder: semuenzaniso, Kana a=3, renji re q ndi ..., uye x=... ndi ...
y-m-48-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: X yawakasarudza ndeye P chaizvo here (kubva ku −1 kusvika ku2)?
y-m-48-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakatsvaga renji re q kune a=3 uye wakariyenzanisa ne x iyoyo here?
y-m-48-03.s.s2.because.model.0: Kana a=3, saka q ndi 0≤x≤6. x=−1 mu P haisi mu q, saka pane x iri p asi isiri q, uye haisi sufficient condition.
y-m-48-03.s.s2.because.model.1: Kana a=3, saka q inobva ku0 kusvika ku6, asi makosha akadai se −1, magumo ekuruboshwe e p, kana −0.5 ari kunze kwerenji iri. Saka 'kana p saka q' haishande.
y-m-48-03.s.s3.prompt: Chengeta p se −1≤x≤2 uye uchinje q kuita |x−a|<3 (pasina equals sign). Renji re a rinoita kuti p ive sufficient condition ye q nderipi?
y-m-48-03.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora q seinterval kune a=−1 ne a=2 uye utarise kana magumo e P ari mukati.
y-m-48-03.s.s3.hint.1: Enzanisa makosha emiganhu a=−1 ne a=2 nekukosha kwemukati a=0.
y-m-48-03.s.s3.r.a: Wakaibata sezvakafanana nenyaya inosanganisira magumo. Kana a=2, saka q ndi −1<x<5, saka tarisa kana x=−1 mu P iri yayo.
y-m-48-03.s.s3.r.b: Tarisa nyaya a=2. q: −1<x<5, uye P ine x=−1.
y-m-48-03.s.s3.r.c: Tarisa nyaya a=−1. q: −4<x<2, uye P ine x=2.
y-m-48-03.s.s3.explain: Magumo ose maviri −1 ne2 e P ari ayo ya P, asi Q iyi haisanganisi magumo ayo. Saka tinoda a−3<−1 ne2<a+3, uye saka −1<a<2.

y-m-48-07.title: Kana ukatarisa mienzaniso yakawanda, inova humbowo here?
y-m-48-07.topic: Ma propositions ane 'dzese', ma counterexamples, nemiganhu yekutarisa mienzaniso
y-m-48-07.goal: Ona kuburikidza nedata rinoratidzwa danho nedanho kuti proposition ye 'pa n dzese' haigone kuratidzwa nekutarisa mitengo mishoma uye kuti counterexample imwe inoita kuti ive yenhema, uye utaure musiyano ne existence proposition.
y-m-48-07.material: Taura proposition inotevera se q. q: 'Pa natural number n dzese, n²+n+41 i prime number.' (n² inoverengwa 'n squared'. Prime number i natural number hombe kupfuura 1 ine ma divisors 1 nayo pachayo chete.) Data rinoratidzwa rimwe pachimwe.
y-m-48-07.thinking.1: Gadzirisa kuvimba kwako kuti kuenderane nedata itsva

y-m-48-07.s.s1.prompt: Data rinoratidzwa rimwe pachimwe. Nguva imwe neimwe, sarudza pfungwa yako nezve q.

y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Shanu i dzimwe chete pa natural numbers dzese. Hatisati taziva kana inoshanda kuna n dzatakasina kuisa.
y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Ma primes achibuda rimwe mushure merimwe i njodzi, saka q inogona kuva yenhema
y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ma primes achibuda rimwe mushure merimwe i chiratidzo chinotsigira q. Kuva nechiratidzo hakusi hwaro hwekutaura kuti i yenhema zvakare.

y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.0.r.d: I chiratidzo kurutivi rwekuti q i yechokwadi. Asi poinzi yakakosha i kuti haisi humbowo.

y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.1.ask: Uchaitei ikozvino? Sarudza zviitiko zvakakodzera. (Kupfuura chimwe kunogona kuva kwakarurama.)
y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.1.after: Kuedza mutengo unotevera zvakananga (kutsvaga counterexample) nekuwana chikonzero chekuti inoshanda pa n dzese (kuratidza) zvese zvakakodzera. Kutarisa mitengo 39 kunowedzera kutenda kwako asi hakuratidzi q.
y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Dzese 39 dzaiva dzakarurama, saka tora q seyaratidzwa uye umire
y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Kunyange 39 i dzimwe chete pa natural numbers dzese. Huwandu hwemitengo yakatarisirwa hahusi chiyero chehumbowo.
y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Verenga mitengo inotevera zvakananga, sa n=40 ne 41
y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Tarisa mu expression chikonzero chekuti i prime uye uedze kuchitsanangura
y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Funga kuti yechi40 inogona kuva yakarurama zvakare, saka hapana chikonzero chekutarisa zvakawanda
y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Kunge kwakarurama kwakasiyana nekuva chokwadi. Counterexample inogona kuonekwa pamutengo wausati watarisa.
y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.2.ask: Unogona kutaura chii nezve q ikozvino?
y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.2.after: Kana n=40, n²+n+41=41×41 haisi prime, saka q i yenhema. Counterexample imwe inoita kuti proposition ye 'pa n dzese' ive yenhema. n=41 i composite zvakare, saka haigone kugadziriswa nekubvisa exception imwe chete.
y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.2.o.a: I prime pa n dzakawanda, saka tora q seyenge yechokwadi uye uishandise sezvayakaita
y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Proposition ye 'pa n dzese' i yenhema kana kunyange chiitiko chimwe chikakundikana. 'Dzakawanda' hazvisi zvinotaurwa ne q.
y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Igadzirise nekubvisa n=40 chete se exception, 'kana n isiri 40, i prime', uye i yechokwadi
y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.2.r.b: n=41 inopawo 41²+41+41=41×43, iyo i composite. Proposition yakagadziriswa nekubvisa exception imwe inofanira kuedzwa zvakare.
y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.2.o.c: 1681 inogona kuva kukanganisa kwekuverenga, saka nonotsa kutonga
y-m-48-07.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Unogona kutarisa 41×41 nekuwanza zvakananga. Kuverenga kwaunogona kutarisa kunofanira kutariswa usati watonga.

y-m-48-07.s.s2.prompt: Ngatitii q' i 'pane natural number n apo n²+n+41 i composite number (nhamba hombe kupfuura 1 isiri prime)'. Tinogona kutaura chii nezve q' kubva paruzivo rwedanho 3 oga?
y-m-48-07.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora mumashoko kuti n yemhando ipi inodiwa kuti q' ive yechokwadi, uye utarise kana 40 ichigutsa mamiriro iwayo.

y-m-48-07.s.s2.o.b: Tinofanira kuongorora n dzakawanda kuti tiziive yechokwadi kana yenhema
y-m-48-07.s.s2.r.b: q' chirevo che 'zvinhu zviripo', saka chiri chechokwadi kana wawana muenzaniso mumwe unoita mamiriro. Ongorora kana 40 iri muenzaniso wakadaro.
y-m-48-07.s.s2.o.c: Yenhema. Nokuti maprimes anobuda kuna n dzakawanda
y-m-48-07.s.s2.r.c: Chirevo che 'zvinhu zviripo' chinobvunza kana pane kunyange muenzaniso mumwe, kwete kana dzakawanda.
y-m-48-07.s.s2.o.d: Hazvigoni kutaurwa kuti yechokwadi. Counterexample iri yeq, kwete yeq'
y-m-48-07.s.s2.r.d: Kukosha kumwe chete n=40 kunoita counterexample kuna q kunova muenzaniso unoita mamiriro muna q'. Enzanisa kuti zvirevo zviviri zvinoshandisa kukosha kumwe chete nenzira dzakasiyana sei.

y-m-48-08.s.s1.o.b: Kuenzana kwaDoyun kwakashanda mumuenzaniso uyu, saka kunogara kuchishanda, uye kwaJimin kwenhema
y-m-48-08.s.s1.r.b: Kutonga kwekuti kuenzana kwaJimin kwenhema kwakarurama. Asi haugoni kutaura kuti kuenzana kwaDoyun kunogara kuchishanda nokuti kwakashanda mumuenzaniso mumwe.
